stemMarkdown: Find each interior angle (in degrees) of a regular polygon with 10 sides. (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The interior angles of an $n$-sided polygon sum to $(n-2) \times 180 = 1440$ degrees. Divided equally among $10$ angles that is $144.0$ degrees each.
altSolutionMarkdown: Or: each exterior angle is $\dfrac{360}{10} = 36.0$ degrees, and the interior angle is its supplement.
